title: AI Automation Business Analyst – Finance
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: BR) is a global Fintech leader delivering technology, communications, data, and analytics solutions to clients across the financial services industry.

At Broadridge, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, where technology and talent come together to create meaningful business impact. Our teams work across functions and geographies to develop solutions that help financial institutions operate more efficiently and effectively.

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **AI Automation Business Analyst** to support Finance Automation and AI initiatives across the organization.

This role will act as the bridge between **Finance business users, technology teams, data teams, and automation developers** to identify opportunities, gather requirements, drive solution delivery, and support AI-enabled transformation initiatives. AI Automation Business Analyst …

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Partner with Finance stakeholders to identify automation and AI opportunities across Finance processes.
* Conduct workshops, process walkthroughs, and discovery sessions to gather business requirements.
* Document current-state and future-state processes, business requirements, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Support implementation of AI and automation solutions using RPA, Power Platform, Power BI, and AI tools.
* Coordinate across business users, developers, data teams, and support teams.
* Facilitate UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and validate delivered solutions against requirements.
* Track project tasks, risks, dependencies, timelines, and status updates.
* Support governance, intake processes, prioritization, and automation inventory management.
* Assist in KPI tracking, ROI analysis, and operational reporting for automation initiatives. AI Automation Business Analyst …

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **3–7 years of experience** in Business Analysis, Automation, or Digital Transformation roles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Experience supporting cross-functional technology projects.
* Familiarity with Finance processes such as **AP, AR, GL, Reporting, or Close processes**. AI Automation Business Analyst …

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to **UiPath, Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Alteryx, SQL, Snowflake, or Oracle Fusion**.
* Understanding of AI concepts including **copilots, chatbots, and prompt engineering**.
* Experience with **Agile delivery methodologies**. AI Automation Business Analyst …

**Key Skills**
--------------

* Business Process Analysis
* AI & Automation Opportunity Assessment
* Requirements Documentation
* Stakeholder Management
* Data Analysis & Reporting
* Problem Solving
* Change Management AI Automation Business Analyst …

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

**Innovation & Transformation:** Work on AI and automation initiatives that transform Finance processes and improve business outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Exposure:** Collaborate with Finance, Technology, Data, Automation, and business teams across the organization.

**AI & Digital Skills:** Gain hands-on exposure to emerging technologies including AI, automation, Power Platform, RPA, and analytics.

**Career Growth:** Build a strong career at the intersection of **Finance, Business Analysis, Technology, and AI**.

**Meaningful Impact:** Help identify and implement solutions that improve efficiency, enhance user experience, and deliver measurable business value.

**Collaborative Culture:** Be part of an inclusive environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and new ideas.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Principal - Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**:

The Principal, Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat will lead workstreams within Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat, with insider threat operations as the priority focus, and act as a subject matter expert for the capability. This is a hands-on analytical role that runs current insider threat operations and leads the design of the agentic AI framework that will optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events.

**About the team:**

The Digital Investigations, Analytics and Insider Threat team runs GSK’s insider threat program end to end, detecting, investigating and responding to threats from those who already have authorised access, and protecting GSK intellectual property and confidential business information from insider risk. The team also covers digital forensics and investigative analytics in support of insider threat and related casework. Alongside running current operations, the team is building an agentic AI framework to optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events, and every role in the team contributes to its development.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Lead insider threat workstreams from definition through delivery, acting as subject matter expert for the capability.
* Conduct digital investigations into suspected policy violation, data theft and insider activity.
* Perform tactical analysis across multiple information streams to detect insider threat indicators, and statistical analysis of insider events to identify patterns, trends and control gaps.
* Develop and refine strategies to deter, detect and respond to threats against GSK intellectual property and confidential business information.
* Build and tune detection logic across DLP and UEBA platforms, balancing coverage against false positive load.
* Engineer and maintain the data pipelines that bring HR, access, endpoint, email and cloud telemetry into the analytics layer.
* Carry out insider threat risk assessments across business units, functions and scenarios.
* Lead the design of the team’s agentic AI framework for insider threat: define the automation and agent architecture for prevention, detection and response, partner with engineering on model and workflow integration, and set the validation criteria for AI-driven outputs.
* Advise stakeholders across GSK as subject matter expert for the capability.
* Mentor colleagues and review their technical or analytical work.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in digital investigations, insider threat or corporate investigations.
* Working knowledge of investigative analytics and case handling.
* Practical experience with DLP and UEBA platforms.
* Strong practical experience in the relevant cyber security domain.
* Proven experience leading workstreams and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Ability to act as a subject matter expert and advise stakeholders confidently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention and User and Entity Behavior Analytics platforms.
* Experience with digital forensics tooling and evidence handling.
* Experience handling matters with HR and Legal involvement.
* Statistical analysis and data visualization skill.
* Relevant certification such as CERT Insider Threat Program Manager, GCITP, GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CompTIA Security+.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

* Experience designing or implementing AI-driven or agentic automation for security operations.
* Typical tools and technologies: DLP, UEBA, EDR, SIEM, forensic imaging and analysis tooling, case management platforms.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Case Management, Cloud Security, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Digital Investigation, DLP Projectors, Forensic Data Analysis, Incident Management, Infrastructure Security, Insider Threat Mitigation, Intrusion Detection, Intrusion Prevention, Investigative Analysis, ML Security, Offensive Cyber Operations, Security Monitoring, Security Operations, Security Planning, Security Protocols, Security Risk, Security Technologies

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: IAM Analyst – IAM & SailPoint IIQ
description:
**Role description**

IAM Analyst – Job Description Role Summary The IAM Analyst will support Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) operations, with a strong focus on identity data quality, orphan account remediation, account correlation, entitlement ownership, access governance, and compliance. The role requires hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ), strong analytical skills, and the ability to work closely with application owners and business stakeholders to drive remediation through closure. Key Responsibilities Analyze orphan account reports and identify accounts that are not appropriately linked to valid parent identities. Perform orphan-account remediation, including account correlation, cleanup, validation, and closure of identified issues. Review accounts eligible for pruning and execute approved cleanup activities in accordance with IAM governance requirements. Identify terminated or inactive users with active access and coordinate with application owners to ensure timely access removal. Perform manual account correlation in SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) to maintain accurate identity-to-account associations. Conduct periodic reviews of Workgroup Owners and Null Entitlement Owners within the User Access Portal (UAP). Identify entitlement ownership gaps and collaborate with stakeholders to assign appropriate owners in accordance with access governance requirements. Validate user roles, permissions, accounts, and entitlements and assist in resolving access-related data inconsistencies. Collaborate with application owners, business stakeholders, and IAM teams to validate account status, obtain necessary approvals, and drive remediation activities to closure. Raise, manage, and track remediation requests through ServiceNow, ensuring governance and audit traceability. Maintain audit-ready documentation, including remediation records, reports, approvals, supporting evidence, and stakeholder communications. Support IAM audit, compliance, access governance, and reporting activities by providing accurate evidence and documentation. Develop and maintain relevant IAM metrics and KPIs to track remediation progress, data quality, and governance effectiveness. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to IAM data quality, identity lifecycle management, access governance, and operational processes. Required Technical / Functional Skills Experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Governance & Administration (IGA). Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and IAM/access governance processes. Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, orphan accounts, account correlation, access provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement governance, and access reviews. Understanding of IAM concepts including RBAC, MFA, identity federation, authentication, authorization, and Segregation of Duties (SoD). Experience identifying and remediating access associated with terminated or inactive users. Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM platform for tracking requests and remediation activities. Strong analytical and data-validation skills, including the ability to use queries, filters, and reports to identify gaps and inconsistencies. Experience supporting IAM audit, governance, compliance, documentation, and evidence-management activities. Ability to develop and maintain IAM operational metrics and KPIs. Proficiency with Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio. Critical Soft Skills Strong out-of-the-box problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate IAM data and access issues independently. High attention to detail, with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and potential compliance issues. Confidence to take initiative, own remediation activities, and drive issues through closure. Strong analytical and investigative mindset. Ability to manage multiple remediation activities and priorities without compromising accuracy. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with application and business teams while remaining resolute in enforcing IAM governance and compliance requirements. Strong documentation skills and commitment to maintaining audit-ready evidence. Proactive and curious, with a willingness to understand the end-to-end IAM ecosystem. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Preferred Experience Experience working in a regulated or highly controlled enterprise environment. Experience supporting IAM governance, audit, compliance, and remediation programs. Exposure to large-scale identity and entitlement data analysis. Familiarity with additional IAM platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, RSA, or CyberArk would be advantageous. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines hands-on SailPoint IIQ experience with strong IAM governance and remediation capabilities. The person should be comfortable analyzing identity and access data, identifying ownership or correlation gaps, coordinating with application owners, documenting evidence, and driving remediation activities to closure while maintaining strong governance and compliance standards.

 **Skills**

SailPoint, RSA, Reporting and Analytics, Identity Governance, Authentication and Authorization, Identity and Access Management, Okta

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Head of Fraud Business Intelligence and Insights
description:
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Head of Fraud Business Intelligence and Insights.**

**The Opportunity**

Fraud and Credit Services (FCS) is a key International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) control function, enabling sustainable growth through proportionate, effective controls across the customer lifecycle. Its fraud and money mule management function combines technology, analytics optimisation and operational expertise to prevent, detect and respond to emerging threats, protecting customers and the Bank from fraud, financial crime and associated Anti Money Laundering (AML) risks. Customer experience remains central, with controls designed to minimize unnecessary friction and provide timely, empathetic support and resolution. FCS partners with business, product, compliance and risk teams to strengthen controls and deliver consistent, intelligence-led outcomes across markets and channels.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* The Head of Fraud Business Intelligence leads the global intelligence, analytics, operations and performance agenda for retail fraud and money mule risk. The role translates data, customer insight and emerging threat intelligence into stronger controls, efficient delivery and measurable customer, risk and business outcomes.
* The role establishes global standards for management information, performance reporting, rule optimisation, and model governance fraud prevention. It defines key performance and risk indicators, identifies material trends and control gaps, challenges underperformance, and coordinates timely remediation with accountable owners.
* The role holder maintains a forward-looking view of the threat landscape through proactive horizon scanning—including AI-enabled scams, synthetic identities, deepfakes, voice cloning, social engineering and evolving mule typologies. It converts this insight into strategic threat assessments, detection priorities, control design and investment decisions, considering the potential customer and financial impact of emerging risks. It promotes responsible use of analytics optimisation, automation and machine learning, with appropriate governance, validation, monitoring and explainability.
* In partnership with fraud operations the role holder oversees demand, capacity, productivity, service quality and customer outcomes, driving continuous improvement across end-to-end processes. This includes reducing unnecessary customer friction, improving decision accuracy, and accelerating case resolution while maintaining operational resilience and robust risk management. Operational insights and customer feedback will inform ongoing control optimisation.
* The role provides concise, decision-focused reporting to senior governance forums on emerging threats, control effectiveness, operational performance, customer impact and investment priorities. It strengthens intelligence networks, shares insights across markets and promotes consistent good practice, adapting implementation proportionately to local regulatory, customer and threat conditions.
* Through this leadership, the role strengthens the organization’s ability to anticipate and disrupt fraud, protect customers and the Bank, improve operational effectiveness, and deliver sustained, evidence-based enhancement of the fraud control environment.

**Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities**

* **Business performance, executive insight and Management Information (MI):** Own the global fraud and money mule performance framework, including consistent metrics, targets, dashboards, forecasting, loss and recovery analysis, control effectiveness, customer impact and executive reporting. Assess the quality and timeliness of MI from control operators and produce accurate, decision-useful reporting for Group submission and senior governance forums.
* **Fraud and mule intelligence:** Build a global view of typologies, networks, attack vectors and emerging trends by combining internal data, cyber intelligence, external intelligence and market insight; translates findings into prioritized action.
* **Fraud Control Optimization and Customer Outcomes:** Continuously tune fraud rules and decision strategies through test-and-learn, back-testing and champion/challenger approaches, balancing detection effectiveness, false positives, customer friction, operational capacity and financial benefit. Monitor customer outcomes, including decision accuracy, complaints, and impacts on vulnerable customers, to ensure controls remain proportionate, accessible and responsive to evolving threats.
* **Model governance:** Set and oversee governance standards for fraud models and analytics optimisation, including inventory, ownership, documentation, validation, performance monitoring, explainability, change control, limitations and remediation.
* **Money mule risk management:** Strengthen capabilities to identify, disrupt and prevent mule activity across onboarding, account behavior, payments and networks, with clear pathways for investigation, intervention, exit and external reporting.
* **Global standards and market enablement:** Define minimum standards, reusable methodologies and common tooling while supporting proportionate local implementation and regulatory requirements.
* **Leadership and influence:** Lead a geographically dispersed team and influence senior stakeholders across markets, Second Line of Defense (SLOD), Third Line of defense (TLOD), Technology and Operations.
* **Governance and assurance:** Provide transparent reporting on performance, control gaps, model or rule deterioration, emerging threats and remediation; escalate material risks promptly through appropriate governance forums.
* **External engagement:** Develop/strengthen external relationships with public/private sector partners and peers; engage with external parties such as local regulators and Card Associations as required.

**Leadership Capabilities**

  

* Strategic leadership, enterprise-wide influence and decisive stakeholder engagement
* Fraud intelligence, link analysis, and threat assessment fraud prevention
* Performance management, data-led insight and compelling executive storytelling
* Fraud rule optimisation, decision strategy and robust model governance
* Inclusive leadership, sound judgement and development of high-performing teams

**To be successful you will:**

  

* Senior leadership experience in retail fraud, financial crime intelligence, or fraud analytics.

title: Lead Analyst - Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose:**

  

The Lead Analyst, Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat will deliver the team's work and act as a senior hands-on contributor within Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat, with insider threat operations as the priority focus. This is a hands-on analytical role that runs current insider threat operations and participates in developing the agentic AI framework that will optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events.

**About the team**:

The Digital Investigations, Analytics and Insider Threat team runs GSK’s insider threat program end to end, detecting, investigating and responding to threats from those who already have authorised access, and protecting GSK intellectual property and confidential business information from insider risk. The team also covers digital forensics and investigative analytics in support of insider threat and related casework. Alongside running current operations, the team is building an agentic AI framework to optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events, and every role in the team contributes to its development.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Run insider threat investigations and detection operations as a senior hands-on contributor.
* Conduct digital investigations into suspected policy violation, data theft and insider activity.
* Perform tactical analysis across multiple information streams to detect insider threat indicators.
* Perform statistical analysis of insider events to identify patterns, trends and control gaps.
* Build and tune detection logic across DLP and UEBA platforms, balancing coverage against false positive load.
* Engineer and maintain the data pipelines that bring HR, access, endpoint, email and cloud telemetry into the analytics layer.
* Carry out insider threat risk assessments across business units, functions and scenarios.
* Participate in developing the team’s agentic AI framework: define insider threat use cases and playbooks suitable for automation, test and validate agentic workflows and AI-generated outputs against real investigations, and feed analyst insight back into the models.
* Deliver assigned work to agreed quality and timelines.
* Support colleagues with peer review and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in digital investigations, insider threat or corporate investigations.
* Working knowledge of investigative analytics and case handling.
* Practical hands-on experience in the relevant cyber security domain.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work independently to a high standard.
* Strong attention to detail in analysis and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention and User and Entity Behavior Analytics platforms.
* Experience with digital forensics tooling and evidence handling.
* Experience handling matters with HR and Legal involvement.
* Statistical analysis and data visualization skill.
* Relevant certification such as CERT Insider Threat Program Manager, GCITP, GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CompTIA Security+.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

* Experience applying automation, scripting or AI-assisted tools to security analytics or investigations.
* Typical tools and technologies: DLP, UEBA, EDR, SIEM, forensic imaging and analysis tooling, case management platforms.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Case Management, Cloud Security, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Digital Investigation, DLP Projectors, Forensic Data Analysis, Incident Management, Infrastructure Security, Insider Threat Mitigation, Intrusion Detection, Intrusion Prevention, Investigative Analysis, ML Security, Offensive Cyber Operations, Security Monitoring, Security Operations, Security Planning, Security Protocols, Security Risk, Security Technologies

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Senior PM Digital Analytics Solution Developer
description:

**Shape the Future of Airbus with Us!**

  

By joining the global **Airbus BC (Cross-Programme)** organization as a founding member of the newly created **Airbus PM Office in India** , you will play a pivotal role in operating projects, programmes, portfolios, and performance management to enable efficient decision-making and execution with a high level of **PM standard.**

  

We are looking for passionate talent, whether you want to **develop your Project Management skills toward seniority** or are **an experienced PM Expert ready to mentor and innovate** , to help us reshape the future of Aircraft programmes through PM excellence .

  

Driven by an entrepreneurial mindset and our Vision 2028 ambition to build an autonomous, high-performing PM Team in India, our mission rests on three core pillars:

* **Driving PM Excellence & Global Competitiveness** : Enabling strategic impact and operational standards locally.
* **Delivering Smart PM Digital Ecosystem:** Deploying data-driven solutions and optimizing cost structures.
* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) , at the forefront of driving PM Operational excellence and PM Digital innovation across Airbus Engineering.

  

You will play a vital role in accelerating the transformation of PM engineering activities by simplifying complex workflows, automating routine tasks, and building a high-tech data ecosystem powered by Skywise, Data Studio, and advanced AI automations.

  

By combining core PM discipline with data analytics and predictive insights, you will eliminate manual friction, deliver real-time operational visibility, and empower engineering leaders to make fast, high-impact decisions. This is your opportunity to combine PM expertise with digital acumen and directly enable the future of aerospace engineering!

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

  

**About the Role**

Are you ready to engineer the next generation of data pipelines, Skywise applications, and AI-driven tools that power Airbus's digital PM ecosystem? In this role, you will serve as the technical engine of the PM Digital Enablement and Analytics Team for the Engineering PM Office (BCXE).

Working in tight synergy with Senior PM Business Analysts, you will transform complex project data into seamless, automated, high-performance Skywise applications (Workshop, Slate, Data Studio) and AI integrations that eliminate manual data crunching and optimize project delivery across transnational engineering perimeters.

  

The **Senior PM Digital Analytics Solution Developer** is the lead technical builder and data engineer within the PM Digital Enablement and Analytics Team, supporting the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) under Digitalization & AI. This role is responsible for taking functional specifications, user stories, and process wireframes created by the PM Business Analytics Solution Leader and architecting them into robust, scalable digital tools, automated data pipelines, and interactive executive dashboards.

  

Utilizing the Palantir Skywise platform (Workshop, Slate, Contour, Data Studio..), Python/PySpark, SQL, and Generative AI (Gemini AI), the developer eliminates repetitive data processing, ensures 100% data sanity, and builds digital solutions that deliver real-time, predictive project performance insights On Time and On Quality (OnT/OnQ).

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Skywise Application & Platform Engineering:
  + Design, build, and deploy custom applications on the Palantir Skywise platform using Workshop, Slate, Contour, and Data Studio.
  + Construct, configure, and maintain object types, action types, and link definitions within the Skywise Manager to accurately represent project entities (schedules, risks, costs, and gate milestones).
  + Build clean, responsive frontend user interfaces tailored for PMBPs, project leaders, and domain heads.
* Data Pipeline Development & Integration:
  + Write, optimize, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to clean, transform, and aggregate data from primary systems (e.g., Planisware, SAP ERP, ARM).
  + Ensure robust data lineage, data quality validation checks, and high query performance across complex multi-project datasets.
* AI & Workflow Automation:
  + Integrate Generative AI features (using Gemini AI) and prompt engineering scripts to automate meeting summaries, action tracking, and predictive delay alerts.
  + Develop low-code/no-code integrations and scripts (e.g., Google Apps Script, AppSheet) connecting Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) with Skywise data layers.
* Technical Quality & Service Delivery (OnT/OnQ):
  + Participate in Agile/SAFe sprint routines, estimate development tasks, and execute user stories defined in the product backlog.
  + Conduct thorough unit testing, bug fixing, version control (Git), and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) activities.
  Maintain complete technical documentation and user guides for all deployed applications and pipelines.

  

**Dimensions** :

* Technical Scope: Lead developer for the PM Digital Enablement and analytics team, responsible for end-to-end Skywise application building (Workshop, Slate, Contour), ontology data modeling, and automated PySpark/SQL pipeline construction.
* Portfolio & User Reach: Direct technical delivery supporting the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) perimeter, serving a user base of PMBPs, Project Leaders, and Domain Heads across Europe and India.
* Data Complexity: Management and integration of multi-source project datasets (schedules, costs, risks, gate reviews) spanning enterprise platforms including Planisware, and Active Risk Manager (ARM).
Transnational & Team Operating Footprint: Core technical builder in a dual-role Agile/SAFe Back Office unit (working in direct pairing with the Senior PM Business Analyst) within the BCX India Extended Make project.  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Educated to a Degree level in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, PM Dashboarding Solution development within engineering, Digital, or industrial sectors
* Experience in dashboarding solution industrialisation and rationalisation ensuring data quality
* Proficiency in scripting languages and web dashboard frameworks.
* Familiarity with enterprise analytics platforms and cloud ecosystems such as Skywise.
Creative problem-solving attitude with fluent English communication capabilities.  

  

**Certifications** :

* Palantir Skywise / Foundry Accreditation:
* Big Data & Cloud Engineering Certifications
Agile & Process Accreditations  

  

**Competencies** :

* PM Processes, Methods & Tools (Autonomous)
* PM Operations (Autonomous)
* Data Science: Data Visualisation & Coms (Autonomous)
* Problem Solving (Autonomous)
* Generative AI Essentials & Prompting (Autonomous)
* Stakeholder Management (Advanced)
* AGILE for Project Management (Autonomous)
Information and Knowledge Management (Autonomous)  

  

**Soft Skills:** High numerical accuracy, structured analytical mindset, proactive problem-solving, attention to detail, and strong oral/written English communication skills for transnational collaboration.

  

**Languages** : Fluent / Negotiation level English (mandatory).

  

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

* Data Analytics & Visualization: Palantir Skywise (Workshop, Data Studio, Contour), Qlik Sense, SQL (basics), Python/PySpark (basics).
* Core PM Workplace: Planisware (E7 / Enterprise), Active Risk Manager (ARM), SAP (ERP/ARP).
* Task & Collaboration: Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Apps Script), Zoho Projects, Jira.
AI & Innovation: Gemini AI (prompt engineering, meeting summarization, report generation  

  

**Your Benefits**

Attractive salary and company benefits

title: Senior Data Analyst I
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Role Summary  
As a Research Senior Data Analyst, you will bridge the gap between technical data  
processing and strategic insights. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of quantitative  
research, from scripting logic and AI-enhanced quality control to advanced statistical modeling  
and dashboarding.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Technical Design & Survey Scripting  

* Advanced Scripting: Lead the programming of complex online surveys using Tivian,

Decipher, Qualtrics, or in-house tools, ensuring sophisticated logic and seamless data  
collection.  

* Study Implementation: Design and execute quantitative sports research studies,

ranging from single-market ad-hoc projects to multi-country trackers.  

* AI & Automation: Proactively utilize AI tools to enhance report quality, conduct

rigorous Quality Control (QC), and standardize workflows to accelerate delivery speed.  
2. Data Analysis & Statistical Modeling  

* Analytical Rigor: Execute meticulous data cleaning, weighting, and tabulation. You

serve as the final gatekeeper for the accuracy of tables and .sav files.  

* Complex Modeling: Perform advanced analyses—including Regression,

Segmentation, TURF, Conjoint, and MaxDiff—using SPSS, Q Research Software, or  
DisplayR.  

* Insight Synthesis: Interpret disaggregated data to provide strategic recommendations

that solve specific client business objectives.  
3. Reporting & Visualization  

* Dashboarding: Design and maintain dynamic visualizations and automated dashboards

using Power BI or Display R.  

* Strategic Collaboration: Partner with senior researchers to interpret data and craft

high-impact client reports and presentations.

4. Agile Project & Stakeholder Management  

* Multi-Project Handling: Independently manage the analytical workstreams for multiple

projects simultaneously, ensuring all data is delivered on time and within budget.  

* Stakeholder Liaison: Interact with diverse internal and external stakeholders across the

global Nielsen network to ensure project alignment and technical excellence.

 **Qualifications**

Who You Are  
  

* Experience: 4–7 years in market research or data analytics, with a heavy focus on

quantitative methodologies.  

* Sports Enthusiast: You live and breathe sports. You understand the nuances of

international events, teams, leagues, and the economics of sponsorship.  

* Technical Mindset: You are a proactive problem-solver who thinks laterally and thrives

in an agile, dynamic team environment.  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in a subject requiring advanced mathematical

analysis and high-level communication skills.

Technical Toolkit  
  
Category Skills & Tools  
Statistical Software - SPSS, Q Research Software, or DisplayR  
Survey Scripting - Tivian, Decipher, Qualtrics, or similar enterprise platforms  
Visualization - Power BI, DisplayR or Tableau  
Data Mastery - Expert Excel (Pivot tables, Macros, Advanced Formulae)  
Programming (Plus) SQL, R, or Python  
  
The Winning Edge (Preferred)  

* AI Certification: A recognized certification in Artificial Intelligence or Machine

Learning is a significant advantage.  

* Project Tools: Familiarity with Monday.com for capacity planning and project tracking.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:

title: Product Analyst
description:
Req ID: 27-0493

Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading global cybersecurity company delivering complete resilience made easy to buy, deploy and use through a partner-first model. Our intelligent BarracudaONE™ platform provides cyber resilience across email, data, applications, networks, and managed XDR within an open ecosystem. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of organizations and partners worldwide, Barracuda delivers industry-leading solutions and support, powered by people and enhanced by AI, for all size business.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.

**Envision Yourself at Barracuda:**

Help turn customer needs into useful email-security capabilities. As a Product Analyst, you will own a clearly bounded feature or administrator workflow, working directly with engineering and a senior product manager from discovery through delivery and measurement. The role combines hands-on product decisions, customer exposure and structured mentorship, with opportunities to develop toward broader product responsibility.

**What You’ll be Working on:**

Investigate customer and administrator needs through interviews, support feedback, usage data and market or competitor research. Translate findings into a clear problem statement and practical options for an assigned feature. Explore how phishing, malware and everyday email-management challenges affect the people using the product.

Define user stories and testable acceptance criteria with senior PM guidance. Partner with engineering and design to evaluate feasibility, refine the backlog and recommend priorities within the agreed scope. Own requirements clarity and follow-through, resolve straightforward product questions collaboratively, and escalate security-sensitive or higher-complexity decisions.

Track feature milestones, dependencies and delivery risks against the agreed roadmap. Support validation and release readiness, prepare internal product briefings or training, and gather customer feedback after launch. Agree relevant indicators with your mentor, analyse adoption and workflow outcomes, and propose evidence-based improvements.

You are accountable for the quality and outcomes of your assigned feature or workflow, not only meeting coordination. A senior product manager retains portfolio strategy, overall roadmap ownership and major prioritisation decisions. You will contribute research and recommendations to those decisions and may support a broader strategic initiative under their direction.

**What you Bring to the Role:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; and 2–5 years of experience in product management, project management, software engineering or a comparable role.
* Adjacent experience is welcome when it demonstrates customer problem-solving and delivery of software outcomes.
* Working knowledge of agile delivery and cybersecurity fundamentals, together with the ability to interpret customer feedback and product data.
* You can communicate requirements clearly, discuss trade-offs with technical colleagues, collaborate across functions and adapt as evidence or priorities change.

* Preferred, not required: familiarity with email administration, Microsoft 365, phishing and malware protection, and basic email authentication concepts such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Product-management certification, including CPM, is also welcome.
* Deep email-security expertise is not expected at entry to this role.

**How you will grow and succeed:**

Regular senior PM coaching, engineering partnership and customer conversations will help you strengthen discovery, prioritisation and analytical judgement. You will collaborate with colleagues across locations on shared product goals. Success means well-defined requirements, transparent delivery risks, useful customer insights and measurable improvement in your assigned area, with progressively greater independence as your skills develop.

**What you’ll get from us:**

A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non-qualifying options.

title: Senior Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Overview of The Department**

Commercial Rating and Underwriting (CRU) sits within the Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) division and forms the institutional credit risk management function within American Express. The CRU team plays the critical role of assessing and managing the risk of institutional exposures across all business units within American Express, and in all regions globally. Credit exposures are primarily generated through corporate and small business card programs, via merchant service relationships where non-delivery risk exists, and among the securities portfolio held for firm-wide liquidity. CRU is led from Salt Lake City with regional teams in New York, London, Singapore , Sydney and India.

In addition to determining the internal credit rating which drives the probability of default of each exposure, CRU also calculates the loss given default of these obligors while underwriting card programs. As a bank holding company, American Express must comply with the highest global banking standards set by Basel and implemented by the bank’s primarily regulatory, the Federal Reserve.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-4 years experience rating and / or underwriting at a leading financial institution or rating agency
* Bachelor’s degree from a top tier university with high GPA and a degree (or substantial coursework) in finance, accounting, economics, or statistics

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Marketing organization. Target Marketing is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. In this role, you will work closely with digital paid channel teams, ensuring flawless media planning, ad set-up, optimization and performance & insights. This vital role will continuously evolve our campaign performance and ensure stringent compliance. You will bring a data-driven approach and an eye toward technological advancements that will make Target first-to-market in the digital media space. It’s critical that this role focus on efficiencies through automation, ensuring business and brand goals are consistently achieved. You will have worked in various digital media and social platforms (IG, TikTok, YouTube, DCM, DMPs, Ad Servers) and you are expected to keep pace with the Digital and Social Advertising industries and help translate relevant industry developments into recommendation and new ideas for Target that lead to more simplicity and efficiencies in nurturing Target’s external advertising presence.

* Deep understanding of full-funnel performance marketing and how media impacts awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.

title: Senior Manager - SN Automation Engineering Product Analyst
description:
Business Introduction

By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product. In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).

**Experience Required**

* Overall 10 years and typically 2–4 years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Requirements Analysis, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Processing, Process Mapping, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), ServiceNow Platform, Software Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

We have an exciting opportunity for you to enhance your career by joining Consumer & Community Banking - Data & Analytics team.

As an Analytics Solutions Manager within Consumer & Community Banking, Marketing, Credit & Customer Experiences , Credit Decisioning Business unit, you will be responsible to operate business-critical controls execution, strengthen operational controls and improve the effectiveness of a complex operating environment by streaming and transforming the way we operate. The role also requires helping to modernize the control environment by finding opportunities for preventive controls, automation, advanced analytics and responsible AI-enabled workflows. description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Lead Quantitative Analytics Specialist** to deliver advanced quantitative analysis and modeling that generate actionable insights and support sound, evidence-based decision-making. **In this role, you will:**

* Lead and contribute to **moderately complex quantitative modeling and analytical initiatives**, including model development, implementation, documentation, testing, and validation

* Analyze data and market developments to support short- and long-term business objectives and defined strategic initiatives

* Consult with partners to define issues/information needs

title: Director - ERP Data Analytics, AI & Automation Platform
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

The Director, ERP Data Analytics, AI & Automation Platform is accountable for the strategy, governance, delivery and operational performance of GSK's ERP data, analytics, AI and automation platforms. The role leads the teams responsible for ERP analytics, data provisioning, visualization, conversational AI and intelligent automation and enterprise reporting capabilities, ensuring these capabilities enable trusted data, actionable insights, operational efficiency and business value across the ERP landscape

The Director leads a portfolio of ERP data, analytics, AI and automation capabilities, including:

* SAP BW and BW/4HANA

* SAP Datasphere (DSP)

The role provides leadership across ERP Data Analytics and ERP AI & Automation teams and is accountable for platform strategy, service delivery, architecture, governance, technology lifecycle management, vendor management and continuous innovation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the ERP Data Analytics, AI & Automation Platform, providing strategic direction, people leadership and operational accountability across analytics, data provisioning, visualization, conversational AI and automation capabilities.

* Drive the adoption of AI, Conversational AI and Intelligent Automation capabilities, including SAP Business Process Automation, delivering measurable business value, productivity gains and enhanced user experiences.

* Oversee platform operations and service delivery, driving engineering excellence through DevOps, automation, performance optimization, service reliability and continuous improvement.
* Partner with business leaders, ERP product teams and enterprise stakeholders to shape demand, prioritize investments and maximize adoption and value realization from analytics, AI and automation capabilities.
* Manage platform budgets, strategic vendors and delivery partners, providing executive oversight of performance, risks, financials and strategic outcomes.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* **18+ years of experience** in ERP, Data & Analytics, AI, Automation or Enterprise Technology roles, including leadership of global teams, business-critical platforms and large-scale transformation initiatives.
* **5+ years of leadership experience** managing enterprise data, analytics, AI, automation or ERP platform teams, including people, budgets, vendors and strategic roadmaps.
* Proven experience defining and executing **technology strategies, operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps** aligned to business objectives.
* Strong experience leading **SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA environments**, including ERP transformation, analytics modernization and enterprise data platform initiatives.
* Deep knowledge of enterprise analytics and data platforms, including **SAP BW, BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere (DSP), SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), Power BI** or equivalent technologies.
* Experience driving **AI, Generative AI, Conversational AI and Intelligent Automation** capabilities, including governance, enterprise adoption and value realization.
* Strong understanding of **data governance, enterprise architecture, cyber security, privacy, risk management, audit and regulatory compliance** within large global organizations.
* Proven experience managing **strategic vendors, managed service providers and multi-million-dollar technology budgets**, with accountability for service delivery and business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to **lead geographically distributed teams and collaborate effectively across regions, cultures and business functions**, preferably within global pharmaceutical, healthcare or other highly regulated industry environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive alignment and build consensus across complex organizations.

**JobRelated Experience sections above that are required for the job.**

* SAP certifications in SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), SAP S/4HANA or SAP BTP preferred.
* Microsoft certifications in Azure Data & AI, Power BI, Data Engineering or AI solutions preferred.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PMP or equivalent project/program management certifications desirable.
* ITIL Foundation (or higher) certification and experience operating enterprise-scale service management models preferred.
* AI, Cloud, Enterprise Architecture or Data Governance certifications desirable.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Customer Feedback Management, Data Governance, Data Visualization, Feature Prioritization, Generative AI, Platform Development, Product Design, Product Development, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmapping, Usability Testing, User Experience (UX), User Experience (UX) Design, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Supply Chain Services team is focused on improving Caterpillar’s overall supply chain performance. This group is responsible for seamless execution of critical processes in the areas of Inventory Management, New Product Introduction (NPI), Continuous Product Improvement (CPI), Supply Chain Solutions, Inventory Control Services and Business Analytics. Supply Chain Services team delivers value by initiating and driving business-critical projects and solutions.

**What You Have:**

Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.

Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

The Role
  
The Customer Experience (CX) charter at Myntra is dedicated to removing friction from the user journey—from app launch to post-delivery support. As a Data Analyst for the CX team, you will be the analytical engine driving our understanding of customer behavior, pain points, and satisfaction metrics. You will translate complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies that directly influence product roadmaps and business operations.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights:** Dive deep into customer interaction data (NPS, CSAT, app drop-offs, and support tickets) to identify root causes of customer friction. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide CX improvements.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis:** Build models to forecast customer behavior, return rates, and seasonal ticket volumes. Anticipate CX challenges before they occur to help operations and product teams stay ahead of the curve.
* **Visual Intelligence:** Design and maintain intuitive, high-impact dashboards (via Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker) that track core CX metrics. Make complex data easily consumable for leadership and cross-functional teams.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor industry benchmarks and competitor CX strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities to ensure Myntra remains the gold standard for e-commerce customer experience in India.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary data partner for CX leaders. Effectively communicate findings, influence strategic decisions, and align analytical outputs with operational realities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams to deploy data-backed solutions and track the efficacy of new feature rollouts.

Required Skills & Qualifications
  
We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates a strong baseline (minimum 2 years of applied experience or a solid Level 2 proficiency) across the following core competencies:
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights (2):** Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and advanced Excel. Strong ability to extract, clean, and interpret large datasets to solve ambiguous problems.
* **Visual Intelligence (2):** Hands-on experience with BI tools. Ability to design dashboards that tell a compelling story rather than just displaying numbers.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis (2):** Experience working with statistical methods, forecasting, and basic machine learning concepts to predict customer trends.
* **Market Intelligence (2):** Familiarity with e-commerce market dynamics, consumer behavior research, and competitive benchmarking.
* **Business Acumen (2):** Strong understanding of how CX metrics (like retention and lifetime value) directly impact the bottom line. Ability to balance customer delight with business profitability.
* **Stakeholder Management (2) & Collaboration (2):** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences and drive alignment across diverse teams.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

The Product Analyst is responsible for supporting product operations and delivering a consistent user experience across sales tools and platforms. This role serves as a key connection between sales users, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Engineering teams by translating product updates into operational readiness and effective user support. Responsibilities include troubleshooting user issues, analyzing support trends, assessing the impact of product defects, maintaining support knowledge, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and the overall user experience.

The Product Analyst is expected to stay current on product releases, enhancements, known issues, and communications from Product Owners and relate these updates to incoming user support tickets. The role requires strong ownership, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to continuously expand knowledge across the broader Sales ecosystem.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to effectively use emerging technologies and Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot to support everyday work and drive measurable process improvements.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Provide frontline product and operational support across CRM and the broader Sales tools ecosystem by troubleshooting user requests in line with established priorities, processes, and SLAs, while collaborating with regional stakeholders, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Stay current on product releases, enhancements, known issues, and updates communicated by Product Owners, and proactively connect these changes to user support tickets, recurring issues, and potential user impact.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills when working with users, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders, ensuring clear, timely, and professional communication throughout issue resolution.
* Triage user-reported issues and quickly assess severity, scope, and business/user impact. Where a potential product defect is identified, promptly raise and coordinate incidents with Engineering teams with appropriate analysis, evidence, and supporting details.
* Use Jira effectively to create and maintain user stories, defects, and bugs with clear problem statements, business/user impact, supporting evidence, acceptance criteria, and appropriate prioritization.
* Take ownership of creating, reviewing, and continuously updating knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and user-support documentation based on recurring issues and established resolutions.
* Analyze incoming support tickets and recurring issue patterns to identify opportunities for proactive support, automation, ticket reduction, and enhancement of the overall user experience.
* Support user onboarding, access provisioning, data-management activities, and other operational processes in accordance with defined business processes, controls, and governance requirements.
* Conduct user training and knowledge-sharing sessions covering product functionality, business processes, new features, and relevant product updates.
* Continuously expand expertise beyond individual CRM applications and develop the ability to support the broader Sales tools and technology ecosystem. Demonstrate learning agility and the ability to quickly adapt to new products, processes, tools, and technical skill sets as business needs evolve.
* Identify enhancements, automation opportunities, and process improvements based on support insights and user feedback, and partner with appropriate Product and Engineering teams to recommend solutions.
* Actively leverage Generative AI tools, including Claude and other approved AI capabilities, as part of day-to-day work and demonstrate tangible AI-enabled process improvements each quarter, with a focus on reducing manual effort, improving turnaround time, enhancing support quality, or increasing operational efficiency.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement by proactively identifying gaps, proposing solutions, documenting learnings, and sharing knowledge across the team.
* Identify enhancements, automation opportunities, and process improvements based on support insights and user feedback, and partner with appropriate Product and Engineering teams to recommend solutions.
* Actively leverage Generative AI tools, including Claude and other approved AI capabilities, as part of day-to-day work and demonstrate tangible AI-enabled process improvements each quarter, with a focus on reducing manual effort, improving turnaround time, enhancing support quality, or increasing operational efficiency.

* 2+ years hands-on experience with enterprise CRM and/or Sales platforms, with the ability to troubleshoot application and user issues and understand their business impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical or product-related information to users, Product Owners, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders.

-----------------

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.

You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

This is achieved by developing scalable data products and delivering cogent insights for partner engagement, creator and consumer support, and go-to-market strategies across YouTube's various relationships with creators, brands, media companies, and distributors.

In this role, you will lead the development of our centralized reporting and analytics solutions. You will partner with Partnerships, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to translate business needs into data products, driving better decision-making at scale. You will own the delivery of these solutions while advocating technical best practices among the community of business intelligence (BI) analysts and data engineers.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
