title: Senior Business Planning & Performance Analyst
description:
About the Role
  
The Senior Business Planning & Performance Analyst owns forecasting, performance reporting and commercial-analysis processes for the India business across a broad portfolio of brands.
  
Acting as a key business partner to the commercial team, the role connects market knowledge, product performance, inventory and forward-looking planning. You will translate data into clear insights, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend actions to improve sales, inventory productivity and overall business performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Performance & Reporting**

* Lead the analysis of key commercial performance indicators across sell-in, sell-out, inventory, availability and assortment performance.

* Develop and continuously improve dashboards and KPIs used to steer the business.

* Identify opportunities and risks and translate them into actionable recommendations.

* Deliver ad hoc analysis to support management decision-making.

**Demand Planning & Forecast**

* Own the creation and maintenance of SKU-level finished-goods forecasts.

* Consolidate, analyze and propose launch orders and monitor launch performance.

* Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, identify gaps, risks and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.

* Support Budget, Best Estimate and other business-planning cycles.

**Assortment & Product Performance**

* Prepare product-rating analysis and assortment recommendations using sales performance, sell-through, stock position, newness performance and trends.

* Maintain SKU classifications and product priorities.

* Monitor collection availability, stock exposure and newness requirements and recommend actions where needed.

* Provide allocation and newness-dispatch recommendations based on performance, range plans and inventory data.

**Markdown Analytics & Monitoring**

* Prepare markdown proposals using stock, sell-out, margin and ageing analysis.

* Monitor markdown performance and exposure versus approved limits, flagging deviations and recommending action.

**Business Partnering**

* Partner with local and regional teams, connecting performance, forecast, inventory and commercial opportunities into clear recommendations.

* Lead regular analytical reviews with Sales, connecting performance against targets, forecasts, open orders, stock availability and inventory risks.

* Recommend actions required to support commercial targets and improve inventory productivity.

* Challenge assumptions and encourage fact-based decision-making across the commercial organization.

* Build strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Brands, Marketing, Controlling, GILP, Customer Operations, Logistics, and regional and global teams.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Improve and standardize planning, reporting and analytical processes.

* Strengthen data quality and reduce manual work through better tools and automation.

* Share best practices and contribute to regional or global improvement initiatives.

**What You Bring**

* Degree in Analytics, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Economics or a related field.

* At least 5 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Planning, Merchandising, Demand Planning or Sales Analysis.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear business recommendations.

* Advanced Excel skills; SAP, BI, Power BI and Databricks knowledge is preferred.

* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

* Proactive, structured and comfortable working in an international environment.

* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

title: Business Analyst, PMO (Release Excellence)
description:
**You Belong at Greenway**

Bring your best and truest self. We celebrate what makes us different and what brings us all together. At Greenway Health, we are committed to an inclusive environment and a culture of belonging as we pursue our purpose of healthier communities, successful providers, and empowered patients. We are united in our goal to build the future of healthcare technology. Join us.

Role Description

The Business Analyst - Release Excellence (AI Native) is an individual contributor within the PMO who helps make software releases more predictable, measurable, and ready for execution. You turn release data into clear insight, strengthen governance, improve recurring workflows, and give leaders and delivery teams a trusted view of readiness, risk, dependencies, and performance.

You will work across PMO, Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and other stakeholders to improve how release information is captured, analyzed, reported, and acted on. You will use approved AI and automation tools where they create practical value - accelerating analysis, reporting, monitoring, and workflow execution while keeping validation and human accountability explicit.

You own the planning and governance layer of the release lifecycle - master release calendars, deployment scope, cut-over coordination, readiness reviews, release metrics, and release documentation - bridging development, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders so updates ship safely, predictably, and with minimal downtime. This is not a release-engineering or engineering/product development role. You will not own software builds, deployment scripting, CI/CD engineering, source-control administration, or final production go/no-go decisions; you prepare and facilitate those decisions and coordinate rollback and incident follow-through with the accountable technical owners.

Key Outcomes

* Release leaders and delivery teams have a timely, accurate, and consistent view of release readiness.

* Risks, issues, dependencies, approvals, and exceptions are visible early and tracked to resolution or escalation.

* Release metrics and dashboards are trusted, repeatable, and useful for decisions.

* Manual reporting and governance administration decline through practical automation and AI-assisted workflows.

* Release processes become more consistent through data-driven analysis, clear requirements, and measurable improvement actions.

* AI-assisted outputs are validated, secure, appropriate, and traceable before operational use.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Maintain accurate release-governance data across milestones, scope, readiness criteria, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, approvals, exceptions, and action items.

* Build and maintain the master release calendar, document deployment scope, and coordinate cut-over windows and branching decisions across multiple cross-functional teams.

* Coordinate Go/No-Go readiness reviews and change and technical review boards (CRB/TRB) - assembling evidence, tracking entry and exit criteria, capturing decisions, and publishing outcomes - while final approval authority remains with accountable owners.

* Map technical dependencies ahead of each release, confirm rollback and contingency plans are documented and agreed with engineering, and coordinate triage and follow-through when deployments fail or post-release defects surface.

* Track release health metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and mean time to restore, and drive continuous-improvement actions from the resulting trends.

* Maintain the release documentation set - deployment instructions, release notes, runbooks, disaster-recovery and rollback references, and cross-team status communications.

* Build and maintain release dashboards, readiness views, recurring reports, and analytical summaries that provide clear visibility into delivery health and release performance.

* Analyze readiness trends, schedule movement, defect and quality signals, dependency aging, exception patterns, deployment outcomes, and other release indicators to identify emerging concerns and improvement opportunities.

* Prepare evidence for release-readiness reviews, governance checkpoints, and leadership discussions. Organize facts, open items, risks, and decision needs without assuming final approval authority.

* Track cross-team dependencies and unresolved blockers, identify aging or execution gaps, and support timely escalation to accountable owners.

* Partner with Release Excellence leadership and cross-functional teams to define metric definitions, reporting standards, data-quality rules, readiness criteria, and governance artifacts.

* Document current-state processes, identify bottlenecks and recurring manual work, and translate findings into clear business requirements, workflow changes, acceptance criteria, and measurable improvement actions.

* Support release retrospectives and recurring operational reviews by synthesizing data, themes, root causes, actions, and follow-through.

* Use approved AI tools to accelerate reporting, summarization, risk sensing, dependency analysis, and process analysis. Validate outputs against trusted source data before use.

* Identify repeatable PMO and release-governance activities that can be automated or converted into controlled workflows, including reminders, evidence collection, approval tracking, status preparation, and recurring reporting.

* Maintain decision logs, governance records, and audit-relevant documentation, so release activity is traceable and accessible.

* Partner with technical teams to understand release signals and constraints while preserving the role boundary between business analysis and technical release engineering.

* Communicate clearly across technical and business audiences, surfacing facts, tradeoffs, risks, and required decisions in a concise and actionable way.

* Contribute to the Release Excellence operating model by improving standards, templates, measures, workflows, and governance practices over time.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience(years including)

* 3 to 8+ years of experience in business analysis, software release management, configuration management, project or program analysis, PMO operations, software delivery, release coordination, quality operations, or a related technical analyst role.

* Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, and cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.

* Experience working in a software development lifecycle environment with Engineering, QA, Product, DevOps, or adjacent delivery teams.

* Experience building reports, dashboards, process documentation, requirements, or governance artifacts from operational data.

* Experience tracking risks, issues, dependencies, milestones, actions, and cross-functional delivery commitments.

* Experience with Agile or Scrum delivery environments. Exposure to scaled delivery models is helpful.

* Experience using AI, workflow automation, or advanced reporting tools to improve analysis, documentation, monitoring, or operational processes is preferred.

Skills

* Business analysis and requirements definition.

* Release readiness and delivery analytics.

* Release planning, scheduling, and cut-over coordination.

* Change and release governance facilitation, including CRB/TRB and Go/No-Go readiness reviews.

* Risk assessment, conflict resolution, and cross-functional negotiation.

* Data validation, reconciliation, and metric definition.

* Dashboarding, reporting, and executive-ready synthesis.

* Risk, issue, dependency, and action tracking.

* Process mapping, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

* Workflow automation and AI-assisted productivity.

* Agile / Scrum and SDLC fluency.

* Stakeholder communication and facilitation.

* Governance documentation and decision traceability.

Abilities

* Turn complex delivery data into concise, decision-ready insight.

* Work across teams without direct authority and maintain disciplined follow-through.

* Distinguish facts, assumptions, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly.

* Identify patterns and process weaknesses without losing sight of operational context.

* Challenge inconsistent data or unclear process steps constructively.

* Balance speed, quality, governance, and practical delivery needs.

* Learn technical release concepts well enough to analyze signals and ask effective questions without taking on release-engineering ownership.

* Maintain accuracy and composure when release timelines are compressed or information is changing quickly.

Tools & Technologies

* Agility or Jira for work, release, risk, dependency, and status tracking.

* Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent Agile, ITSM, and pipeline tooling.

* Git-based source control and AWS or Azure cloud environments at a working-familiarity level.

* Confluence or equivalent collaboration and documentation platforms.

* Dashboarding and analytics tools used by the organization.

* Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity and reporting tools.

* Approved generative AI and AI-assisted analytics tools.

* Workflow automation tools used for notifications, approvals, evidence collection, and recurring PMO processes.

* Working familiarity with CI/CD concepts, source control, deployment pipelines, testing workflows, and environment progression sufficient to interpret release information; hands-on engineering ownership is not required.

AI Usage and Accountability Requirements

* Use only approved AI tools and follow organizational requirements for confidentiality, security, data handling, and responsible AI use.

* Validate AI-generated summaries, analyses, risk signals, recommendations, and stakeholder communications against trusted source information before operational use.

* Do not treat AI output as approval, evidence, or a final decision without appropriate human review.

* Maintain traceability for material AI-assisted analysis when it informs release governance, escalation, or leadership communication.

* Use AI to reduce repetitive effort and improve analytical consistency while preserving human judgment for exceptions, tradeoffs, escalation, and recommendation quality.

* Escalate suspected AI errors, data-quality issues, inappropriate outputs, or governance concerns.

* Keep final ownership with accountable people. AI may support a release decision, but it does not own go/no-go, risk acceptance, production change approval, or stakeholder accountability.

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

* Accuracy and timeliness of release-readiness reporting.

* Completeness and quality of release-governance data and decision records.

* Reduction in manual effort required to prepare recurring release reports and governance artifacts.

* Visibility and aging of unresolved risks, issues, dependencies, approvals, and actions.

* Adoption and consistency of release metrics, readiness criteria, and reporting standards.

* Quality and usefulness of analytical insights provided to Release Excellence leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Completion and measurable impact of process-improvement and automation initiatives within assigned scope.

* Evidence that AI-assisted outputs are reviewed, validated, and used in accordance with governance requirements.

* Contribution to improving release predictability, readiness transparency, and operational discipline over time.

AI Competency Alignment & Proficiency Expectations

* Target Proficiency: Intermediate for the competencies below.

* Generative AI Reporting and Documentation - independently develops release and governance updates using approved generative AI tools, improves clarity and stakeholder relevance, and uses AI-assisted summaries to streamline reporting workflows.

* AI-Powered Delivery Performance Monitoring - analyzes routine release and delivery trends using AI-assisted monitoring tools and uses predictive indicators to identify potential risks or bottlenecks.

* Predictive Risk and Issue Management - uses AI-assisted monitoring to identify emerging concerns, supports mitigation tracking, and maintains structured risk and issue records.

* AI-Assisted Dependency Management - manages routine dependency tracking with AI-assisted planning tools, identifies dependency risks or execution gaps, and supports milestone coordination.

* AI-Enabled PMO Process Optimization - uses AI-assisted workflow tools and automation insights to improve operational consistency, standardization, and efficiency.

* AI-Driven PMO Governance Automation - uses approved workflow automation to improve reminders, evidence collection, governance compliance, approval tracking, and audit readiness.

* AI-Enabled Stakeholder Communication Management - uses AI-assisted summaries and collaboration tools to improve communication clarity while maintaining structured follow-through.

* Responsible AI Governance in PMO - validates AI-generated project and release insights, protects data, follows governance controls, and reinforces ethical and accountable AI use.

Authority and Autonomy

* Independently manage assigned analysis, dashboards, governance artifacts, reporting routines, requirements, process documentation, and improvement of work within established PMO standards.

* Raise data-quality concerns, readiness gaps, unresolved dependencies, process-control issues, and emerging risks to accountable owners.

* Recommend process, reporting, metric, workflow, and automation improvements based on evidence.

* Facilitate analysis and readiness discussions within assigned scope.

* Own the master release calendar, release documentation set, governance cadence, and readiness-review logistics within established PMO standards.

* Do not independently approve production go/no-go decisions, accept material release risk, authorize production changes, or override accountable functional owners.

* Do not own software builds, deployment scripting, CI/CD engineering, source-control administration, or production deployment execution unless a separate role assignment explicitly grants that responsibility.

It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent(s) may be asked to perform other duties as requested. title: Analytics & Modeling Analyst - Flood Modeller
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Practical programming experience in Python; familiarity with scientific computing environments, and experience with R, C/C++, Fortran, CUDA, or bash is advantageous
* Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model training and validation, overfitting, and model evaluation; experience with one or more deep learning models such as LSTMs or CNNs and frameworks such as PyTorch
* Demonstrated interest in ML, flood modelling, environmental systems, geospatial analytics, or related scientific applications
* Knowledge of elevation model refining strategies, such as cleaning of LiDAR data and artefact removal, is advantageous
* Familiarity with large-scale model development projects on HPC environments in Linux is advantageous
* Experience working with geospatial foundation models is advantageous
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* MSc in GIS, Hydrology, Hydraulics, Coastal and Ocean Engineering, Climate Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline

**Responsibilities**

* Join a collaborative scientific team building high-resolution, large-scale hydrologic and hydraulic models and contribute to model components, data pipelines, validation, and research
* Contribute to the development and application of large-scale flood hazard model components, including elevation models and other geospatial input layers, stochastic rainfall, rainfall-runoff processes, hydraulic routing, floodplain inundation, and flood-defence failure mechanisms
* Calibrate and validate model components with a focus on GIS, using observed data, published research, and benchmark datasets, including comparisons between simulated and observed flood extents and depths
* Evaluate model outputs such as flood footprints, hazard metrics, and loss patterns using statistical methods, visualisation, and GIS tools
* Advance flood model input layer preparation, including elevation models, land use data, and remotely sensed data, through research, evaluation, and implementation of novel scientific and computational techniques
* Explore, prototype, and evaluate AI and ML methods for model-development challenges including surrogate modelling, spatial downscaling, feature extraction, anomaly detection, data processing, emulator development, and workflow automation
* Contribute to the development of reproducible scientific workflows, code repositories, and data-processing pipelines using modern software development practices
* Communicate research findings and modelling insights to internal stakeholders, clients, and the broader scientific community
* Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative culture through knowledge sharing, constructive review, and continuous learning

**About the Team**  
Our Model Development team brings together scientists, engineers, and data specialists to build natural catastrophe models for hazards including tropical and extra-tropical storms, winter storms and convective storms, coastal and inland flooding, and tsunamis. The Inland Flood team develops high-resolution, large-scale hydrologic and hydraulic models spanning hazard through loss, combining observations, reanalysis and climate data, numerical and statistical modelling, engineering methods, and data assimilation. As AI and machine learning evolve, we integrate them selectively alongside established physical and statistical approaches to improve model development, data processing, quality assurance, and scientific insight. By joining the team, you will contribute to meaningful scientific work, grow as a GIS specialist or flood modeller, and help advance Moody's position as a global leader in catastrophe risk assessment.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Product Support Analyst, Associate
description:
### **Description**

The Product Support Analyst Associate will provide dispatch and customer support services to Infor customers in the United States who use Infor Restaurants POS products.

The role involves receiving customer support requests, understanding and documenting customer issues accurately, creating support tickets, assigning the appropriate priority, and routing cases to the correct support team.

The ideal candidate should have excellent written and verbal English communication skills, strong customer-service skills, good organization, and the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Basic knowledge of POS systems and PC technology will be beneficial.

The Infor Restaurants support team operates 24/7, so candidates must be flexible to work across shifts, including India overnight hours, based on business requirements.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Answer customer support calls and understand the customer's issue clearly.
* Create support tickets with complete and accurate descriptions of customer issues.
* Provide professional, courteous, and polite customer service in accordance with established procedures.
* Assign the appropriate priority level to tickets based on the nature of the issue.
* Route support tickets to the appropriate team for further investigation and resolution.
* Monitor and manage email, voicemail, and other support channels for new customer requests and create tickets as required.
* Learn and effectively use the team's ticketing and phone systems.
* Handle multiple customer requests and tasks effectively in a fast-paced support environment.
* Support administrative activities such as reporting, document distribution, and other assigned projects.
* Work collaboratively with team members to provide a positive customer-support experience.
* Remain flexible to work different shifts based on the requirements of the 24/7 support operation.

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 0–2 years of experience in dispatch, customer support, technical support, or a similar environment.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with US-based customers.
* Ability to understand a customer's issue and translate the information into a clear and accurate support ticket.

title: Inventory Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

The **Inventory Analyst** is responsible for collecting and interpreting inventory data from our ERP system, evaluate the efficiency of overall stock holding and help identify streamlined purchasing methods. Contribute to the monthly inventory forecasting process, providing clear instruction for the branches to ensure we have an accurate account of inventory levels for the coming months to meet our cash targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Inventory Forecasting**

· Analyse inventory data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization.

· Coordinate the monthly inventory planning processes, ensuring all data is collected in a timely manner, and regional reviews take place before submission to Longview.

· Weekly monitoring of perpetual inventory levels to ensure we are in line with forecast and highlighting areas of concern.

· Work closely with branches to improve inventory performance against targets, identifying specific customers or elements within the supply chain that are contributing to any significant change in gross inventory.

· Analyse and report on specific customer Actual v Forecasted sales, identifying fluctuations that could affect our overall stock holding.

· Analyse aged 1 year + or slow-moving inventory, report back to the branches and track commercial claim opportunities.

· Provide regular updates on rejecting material values, helping to ensure branch personnel are taking appropriate action.

**Purchasing Responsibilities**

· Monitor purchasing patterns at the Int branches and track value of open order books to ensure management is aware of any fluctuations that may affect cash targets.

· Monitor the information held within the ERP database to ensure Materials personnel can make informed decisions when deciding what to purchase

· Identify continuous improvement opportunities within purchasing and contribute to updating processes and procedures.

· Assist with training new buyers/planners to ensure all buyers use the ERP system as expected and are aware of relevant procedures.

· Support new product introductions (NPI) and product lifecycle inventory planning.

**General Analysis & Reporting**

· Develop and maintain inventory reporting, dashboards, and KPIs (e.g. stock turns, ageing, service levels).

· Help identify and drive opportunities for best practice improvements within the dept.

· When required, assist with planning & purchasing activity at specific branches

· Interact with Logistics colleagues to ensure we can consolidate shipments between branches and move products by the most economical means.

· Assist when required with data analysis for other key parts of the business.

· Maintain and improve master data accuracy within ERP/MRP systems.

· When required, assist with planning & purchasing activity at specific branches

· Interact with Logistics colleagues to ensure we can consolidate shipments between branches and move products by the most economical means.

· Assist when required with data analysis for other key parts of the business.

· Maintain and improve master data accuracy within ERP/MRP systems.

**Required Qualifications**

· 3 years’ experience in inventory planning, forecasting, purchasing, or supply chain analysis.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large volumes of data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

· Experience monitoring inventory performance, stock levels, and forecasting accuracy.

· Experience using ERP/MRP systems to manage inventory and purchasing data.

· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to create reports, dashboards, and KPI analysis.

· Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate master data.

· Experience producing and presenting management reports and recommendations.

**Desirable Requirements**

· Experience in a manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or supply chain environment is preferable.

· Experience supporting new product introductions (NPI) and product lifecycle management.

· Understanding of purchasing processes and supplier management.

· Knowledge of logistics, transportation planning, and shipment consolidation.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:

The **Demand Planning** (**Forecast) Analyst** is responsible for maintaining accurate demand data, generating and monitoring forecasts, and identifying opportunities to improve forecast accuracy. The role analyses trends, investigates forecast variances, and develops reporting to support inventory optimization and on-time delivery. Working closely with supply chain stakeholders, the analyst contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning processes, inventory performance, and overall operational efficiency.

· Assist in the monthly generation of statistical forecasts; identify outliers and investigate for root cause.

· Monitor forecasts to identify deviation and bias; recommend improvements.

· Design and construct reports using data from the data warehouse and the forecasting system.

· Prepare and publish reports pertaining to forecasting and inventory.

· Develop detailed process flow diagrams and supporting documentation

**Required Qualifications**

· Thorough knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory planning, and supply chain management principles.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend process improvements.

· High attention to detail and accuracy when managing data, forecasts, and reports.

title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Corporate Functions
description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

CGA & Corporate Secretariat Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Corporate Government Affairs and the Corporate Secretariat. This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Corporate Functions Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Corporate Functions Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the products supported.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner & partner with the business to realise product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional, technical specifications needed to deliver new product, changes and support configuration or code delivery.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and implement AI, automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Business knowledge in a relevant functional domain & familiarity with associated technology platforms that enable them (e.g., IT, Internal & External Communications, Corporate Secretariat), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g.Agile methodologies)
  

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.
  

**Skills**

Agile Kanban, Agile Methodology, Business Analysis, Corporate Secretarial Work, Documentations, Product Lifecycle, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Requirements Gathering, Scrum (Agile), Sprint Planning, Stakeholder Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Sr Analyst Performance & Insights
description:
**Pyramid Overview**

Roundel is Target’s retail media network. Roundel designs and delivers impactful marketing for brands and their agencies, resulting in engagement and incremental sales that can be measured online and in-store, all within premium, brand-safe environments.

**About the Job**

The Performance & Insights team enables advertisers to measure, understand, and optimize the business impact of their media investments through advanced analytics, measurement strategy, experimentation, visualization, data-driven storytelling, and emerging AI-enabled analytical capabilities.

As a Senior Analyst, Performance & Insights, you will lead scaled and custom analytics initiatives that improve advertiser outcomes and advance Roundel's analytical capabilities. You will translate complex business questions into structured analytical approaches, apply advanced statistical and measurement techniques, and develop actionable recommendations that support better media and investment decisions.

A key focus of this role will be turning recurring analytical questions into repeatable capabilities through reusable frameworks, automated analyses, dashboards, statistical models, and modular solutions adopted across advertisers, categories, campaigns, and Performance & Insights teams. You will strengthen statistical rigor by applying established statistical tests, experimental designs, regression models, and time-series methods; validating findings; and establishing clear, defensible criteria for interpreting results.

Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, hands-on applied statistical and causal measurement expertise, digital media measurement knowledge, technical proficiency, visualization and storytelling skills, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to work across business, analytics, and technology teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Measurement strategy & expertise:** Translate business questions into practical analytical and measurement approaches, choosing suitable methods and explaining assumptions, bias and limitations.

* **Statistical rigor & evidence validation:** Apply statistical tests, confidence intervals, power and sample-size calculations to assess performance differences and determine whether results are meaningful.
* **Develop predictive and diagnostic analytical capabilities:** Use regression, time-series and predictive analysis to understand performance drivers, conversion behavior, seasonality and potential growth or investment opportunities
* **Lead and deliver custom analytics projects for the P&I team:** Deliver custom analyses of campaign, audience, creative and customer performance, for existing and emerging business questions
* **Productize repeatable analytical work:** Convert recurring analyses and business questions into reusable modules, frameworks, datasets, metrics, code packages, dashboards, and self-service products with clear inputs, quality checks, statistical validation and guidance for interpreting results.
* **Analytical storytelling & decision support:** Present clear recommendations, work with business, measurement, product and data teams, and help analysts adopt new methods and tools.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Work with Product, Measurement, Data Strategy, GTM, and P&I teams to align analytical capabilities with business needs.
* **Responsible GenAI usage:** Explore responsible uses of GenAI to simplify analytical workflows, automate routine work and support insight generation while maintaining appropriate validation and oversight.

**About you:**

* 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, retail analytics, measurement, data science, or a related analytical discipline.
* Master's degree in Statistics or Economics, Data Science, Analytics or a related quantitative field.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of descriptive statistics; hypothesis testing (t-tests and z-tests); confidence intervals; Pearson and Spearman correlation; proportion and chi-square tests; and the ability to interpret meaningful performance differences and uncertainty.
* Practical experience with A/B testing and experimental design, including test/control groups, randomization, statistical power, and sample-size calculations. Ability to assess bias, assumptions, and limitations and explain whether results support a business conclusion.
* Ability to apply linear, multiple linear and logistic regression, time-series analysis, and outlier detection or robust statistics to business problems.
* Advanced SQL and working proficiency in Python for statistical analysis and reusable workflows; experience with relevant libraries such as pandas, NumPy, SciPy or statsmodels and cloud platforms such as GCP or Azure.
* Good to have: ANOVA, bootstrap methods, multiple-comparison corrections, matched controls, difference-in-differences, segmentation/clustering, response models or other advanced predictive and causal techniques.

* Hands-on familiarity with Generative AI and large language model applications in analytical workflows, including areas such as prompt design, code assistance, analytical agents/workflows, governed knowledge retrieval, and automated synthesis.
* Experience building analytical solutions and communicating findings clearly, with working knowledge of BI tools and practical GenAI applications.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Consultant, Data Quality Analytics
description:
**Consultant, Data Quality Analytics**

Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte-scale data sets and shape brand new methodologies, tools, statistical methods, and models. What’s more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts, and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data.

**What you’ll achieve:**

As a Consultant, you will lead high-impact data quality programs that strengthen monitoring, validation, and defect remediation. You will automate checks, rollout policies, and measure improvements with quality KPIs across critical data products. You will collaborate with engineering and analytics teams to deliver scalable solutions and robust documentation.

Prove that the Knowledge & Intelligence layer's data can be trusted - and keep proving it. This is the data-trust and AI-readiness role for the governed knowledge spine that grounds AI agents on verified, provenance-backed facts. You trace where every fact came from, measure its quality and freshness, and turn those signals into the dashboards and evidence that show the layer meets its AI-ready data standard - continuously, not as a one-time sign-off. When trust, lineage, or quality drifts, you're the first to see it and the one who makes it visible to everyone else.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Consultant** on our **Data Quality Analytics** team.

**You will:**

* **Lineage & traceability.** Trace every served fact back to its source and transformations - the record that makes the layer explainable and auditable.
* **Quality signals.** Measure completeness, freshness, and schema drift across the layer's data products, and track them against their SLAs.
* **Active-metadata dashboards.** Build and own the dashboards (Splunk, Elastic / Kibana, SQL) that keep trust, freshness, and quality signals live for the engineering teams and for leadership.
* **AI-readiness evidence.** Assemble the conformance evidence that shows each data product meets the AI-ready data standard - at every phase gate, across all its dimensions.
* **Trust & compliance reporting.** Surface trust-tier coverage, provenance completeness, and PII / sensitivity-labeling status - the evidence audit and governance rely on. **Grounding discipline.** Nothing ships ungrounded; you flag anything that can't be traced back to a source.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Strong data-analysis background - SQL-fluent, comfortable tracing data across systems and turning messy signals into clear, trustworthy views. Comes with 12-15 years of experience.
* Hands-on experience building report and monitoring dashboards (Splunk, Elastic / Kibana, Grafana, or similar). Experience with data quality, lineage, or data governance - measuring completeness, freshness, and drift, and evidencing it.
* Familiarity with data provenance and PII / sensitivity concepts - enough to report on them accurately.
* Comfort with knowledge graphs and semantic data - the substrate you'll trace and query (SPARQL a plus).
* Strong communication - you make trust and readiness legible to engineers, auditors, and leadership alike.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or related field.
* Certifications or vendor credentials for data quality or cloud data platforms.

**Who We Are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.  
  
Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**.

Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.  
  
The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
* Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
* Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
* Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
* Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
* Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
* Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
* Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
* Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
* Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
* Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

title: Tableau CRM Analytics
description:

**Your Role**
-------------

* Develop complex business logic and analytical queries using SAQL and SQL.
* Create, schedule, and optimize Data Syncs, Dataflows, and Recipes for efficient data processing.Implement advanced data modeling, joins, and cogrouping techniques across multiple datasets.
* Ensure data security by configuring Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance for row-level access control.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Optimize dashboard performance, query execution, and data pipeline efficiency.
* Work closely with Salesforce Administrators, Developers, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to deliver analytics solutions.
* Manage CRMA data ingestion from Salesforce objects, ensuring accurate mapping of fields and data types.Troubleshoot dashboard, dataset, and dataflow issues while maintaining data quality and governance.Follow best practices for CRMA development, deployment, and performance tuning.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Required 5-8 years of experienced **Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) Developer** to design, build, and optimize enterprise-level dashboards and data pipelines.
* Having experience in developing high-performance CRMA dashboards by customizing **JSON** structures, navigating CRMA’s unique architecture and limitations compared to tools like Tableau.
* Experienced in building advanced query using **SAQL** and **SQL** (utilizing CRMA-specific **cogrouping** ), managing data engineering via optimized **Data Syncs, Dataflows, and Recipes** , and enforcing strict row-level security using **Security Predicates** and **Sharing Inheritance** .
* To succeed, should have deep understanding of core Salesforce fundamentals, including objects, permission sets, data types, and how CRMA ingests platform data.
* **Primary Skills (Must-Have)** **CRMA Dashboarding** : Deep knowledge of CRMA dashboard limitations and capabilities vs. Tableau. **JSON Customization** : Hands-on experience editing dashboard JSON for advanced layouts and steps. **SAQL Expertise** : Advanced scripting in Salesforce Analytics Query Language for complex logic. **Data Pipelines** : Building, scheduling, and optimizing Recipes, Dataflows, and Data Syncs. **Recipe Optimization** : Ability to split data recipes by execution frequency to maximize performance. **Row-Level Security** : Implementing Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance within CRMA.
* **Secondary Skills (Highly Preferred)** **Core Salesforce Architecture** : Solid grasp of standard/custom objects, fields, and permission sets. **CRMA Data Mapping** : Deep understanding of how Salesforce data types ingest and translate into CRMA. **SQL & Complex Joins** : Strong background in relational database joins to accelerate data modelling. **Cogrouping Mastery** : Understanding CRMA-specific multi-dataset joining techniques that differ from traditional SQL.

title: Senior Data Mapping Analyst, Servicing Transaction Mgmt
description:
**Position Summary:**

The Servicing Transaction Management department is responsible for the loan boarding and deboarding process. This role relates to converting other servicers data to upload into Onity’s loan servicing system and subsequently validating the data uploaded versus the data and/or documents received for all newly boarded loans. This position is responsible for developing projects in the loan boarding and related applications for bulk and flow transfers. The Data Mapping Analyst will analyze and program boarding files, as well as participate in data mapping, researching issues and testing the application and data loads. This position requires strong analytical skills and technical knowledge to support the Loansphere Loan Boarding System (LLB) as well as the Onity proprietary Loan Boarding Tool. The Data Analyst will work closely with various parties including their immediate team, business units, prior servicers and other technical teams to coordinate data transformation. This role will also be responsible for implementing tools to support transfer efficiency, as well as keeping documentation updated and communicating changes to processes, procedures and tools.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensures that new loan programs or changes are incorporated into the boarding process.
* Analyzes boarding error messages to determine root cause and remediates issues.
* Creates edit checks within the Loan Baording System to recognize errors prior to boarding.
* Develop and configure the Loan Boarding System, as well as supporting toolsets such as SharePoint to support boarding data management. This includes mapping of seller/prior servicer data, create and update tables and define and implement solutions for converting the data.
* Perform testing to support trials and production. Review error reports and document/communicate issues found. Determine solutions for issues.
* Define requirements for and implement tools and processes to improve data quality and visibility.
* Work closely via meetings and conference calls with Business Unit Leads and prior servicers to ensure data transformation is accurate and clearly communicated.
* Update/create procedures and continue to enhance and optimize the boarding process, including tool enhancements as required.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements (i.e. RESPA, USAP, Sarbox, etc.).
* Produce and review required control reporting.
* Meet all established milestones for deboarding/boarding project plans.
* Follow all established procedures regarding boarding/deboarding.
* Ensure all quality steps are completed and documented.
* Escalate any possible deadline misses.
* Communicate boarding/deboarding expectations with internal and external clients regularly.
* Organize meetings with internal and external clients with documented meeting minutes.
* Self-driven, should be able to handle high pressure.
* Must identify ways to automate processes and set up controls when required.
* Willing to work extra hours as per the process requirements/Flexibility to work in accordance with Business requirements.

**KEY RESULTS AREA:**

* Reduce number of Servicing Transaction Management related customer complaints by a designated management percentage year over year.
* Maintain quality at 100%.
* Meet all milestones related to the loan boarding process.
* Timely responses to servicers and internal parties.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* This position requires a significant amount of mortgage servicing knowledge, including but not limited to, the ability to identify and understand various data points utilized within loan servicing systems to successfully service loans and interpret mortgage loan collateral and loan servicing documentation used in conjunction with the data to service loans.
* Experience with different loan programs such as ARM’s, HELOC’s, buydowns, Commercial, etc.
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or minimum of five (5) + years’ mortgage servicing experience.
* SQL experience preferred
* Minimum of 4 years’ experience working with LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB).
* MSP servicing system experience required.
* Advanced PC skills: Microsoft applications, including Excel and Access Database, Monarch, Adobe, SharePoint and LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB).
* Ability to deal with complex difficult problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations.
* Ability to set up controls and being able to speak to auditors/QA teams regarding process
* Ability to identify inconsistencies or issues in data and help come up with solutions
* Set up organized structure for incoming mapping changes and tracking for all internal and external partners.
* Ability to work independently, meet established deadlines, be very detail orientated, and have excellent organizational skills.
* Organizational skillset able to handle multiple transactions at the same time
* Ability to easily adapt to changes in processes, procedures and priorities.
* Proven strength in interpreting business requirements and implementing them in application or operational tools.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external clients to determine requirements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with Empower or Encompass origination system a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and attention to detail and accuracy.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you a data and analytics professional with hands-on experience building automations and analytics solutions, and curious about applying AI-enabled development to enhance how you deliver? As an **Analytics Solutions Associate** within the **Finance Data and Insights** organization, you will partner closely with controller teams, treasury analytics, and technology partners to deliver accurate, timely, and well-controlled financial data and automation outcomes. You will help identify and assess automation and analytics opportunities, translate business requirements into production-grade solutions, and improve processes and controls through modern automation and data practices. This role emphasizes intelligent automation and analytics engineering, using UiPath to automate repeatable finance processes and Alteryx (or similar) to prepare and transform data for reporting and business intelligence consumption. You will also apply AI-enabled development practices to accelerate productivity and support the delivery of business intelligence and workflow solutions.

Job responsibilities

* **Develop** and maintain workflows to ingest, cleanse, blend, and transform finance data for downstream reporting and analytics.
* **Design**, **build**, **test**, and **maintain** UiPath automations (attended and unattended) that eliminate manual effort across controller and treasury processes, including reconciliations, data movement, report generation, and control checks.
* **Partner** with business users to document current-state processes, user pain points, decision points, data inputs, and control requirements; **translate** findings into automation candidates and business intelligence/workflow requirements.
* **Build** and iterate on dashboards and self-service analytics using Tableau, Sigma, ThoughtSpot, or similar platforms to support controller, treasury, and cross line of business stakeholders.
* **Apply** AI-enabled development tools to accelerate productivity in building automations, workflows, SQL, and documentation, and to prototype AI-assisted features in business intelligence and workflow solutions.
* **Identify** patterns and anomalies in data and **use** insights to drive process improvements, strengthen controls, and surface additional automation opportunities.
* **Support** agile delivery practices including backlog management, user story writing, sprint planning input, stakeholder demonstrations, and clear communication of progress, risks, and value.
* **Operate** within a well-controlled financial services environment by following version control, peer review, testing, documentation, and adherence to data governance and access-management standards.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Demonstrated ability to translate business processes into clear requirements, user stories, process maps, and automation designs.

* Strong stakeholder management and written/verbal communication skills across finance, technology, product, and senior business audiences.

* Experience with modern business intelligence and visualization tools: Tableau, Sigma, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, or similar.
* Experience working with finance, controller, treasury, or financial reporting stakeholders to understand business processes, document requirements, and deliver automation or analytics solutions.
* Experience with Python, Databricks, Snowflake, or other big-data query and development tools.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, LLM Suite, Genie, Spotter, Microsoft Copilot) applied to coding, SQL, workflow design, documentation, testing, and/or building or supporting AI-assisted features within business intelligence or workflow solutions (for example natural-language querying, auto-generated commentary, intelligent routing, document extraction).
* Familiarity with agile product practices: backlog refinement, user story creation, minimum viable product definition, sprint planning, and stakeholder demonstrations.
* Ability to frame business cases for automation and analytics initiatives (productivity, control improvement, cycle-time reduction, scalability, reduced manual effort).
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, lineage, access management, and control expectations in a financial services environment.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: Analytics Engineer - Senior Analyst
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

In the Data & Analytics Senior Analyst role, you will work with Data Engineers, Power BI Developers, Data Architects, QA teams, product owners, project teams, and business/practice stakeholders to design, develop, test, deploy, and support Huron’s enterprise analytics and reporting solutions. This role combines hands-on data engineering capability with Power BI and business intelligence development responsibilities.  
This role will support Corporate IT, Software Development, and business/practice teams across the US and India. Under limited guidance, you will contribute as an independent technical analyst responsible for delivering data pipelines, curated datasets, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and analytics features that improve how Huron uses data to make decisions.  
You will participate in the full analytics delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design support, data engineering, data modeling, Power BI development, DAX calculations, testing, performance tuning, documentation, deployment support, and issue remediation. You will also help junior analysts understand project context, technical standards, QA expectations, and reusable delivery practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and support Data & Analytics solutions, including ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, curated datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, Databricks, cloud data services, and relational or analytical databases.
* Develop and optimize Power BI reports and dashboards that translate business requirements into actionable insights, interactive visuals, and standardized reporting experiences.
* Build and maintain Power BI data models, relationships, measures, calculated columns, DAX logic, report pages, filters, drill-throughs, and security-aware reporting structures.
* Work with data from Databricks, cloud data platforms, data warehouses, APIs, files, and relational databases to create reusable reporting-ready datasets.
* Partner with Product Owners, BI Developers, Data Engineers, QA, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, define metrics, validate business logic, and align report outputs to business definitions.
* Create technical specifications, data mappings, source-to-target logic, test plans, deployment notes, and support documentation based on conceptual designs and business requirements.
* Independently troubleshoot data quality, data refresh, semantic model, DAX, visualization, access, pipeline, and report performance issues.
* Support peer reviews, code reviews, pull requests, release readiness, and deployment validation using Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices where applicable.
* Collaborate closely with QA to validate data accuracy, visual behavior, dashboard functionality, model relationships, and defect remediation.
* Support UAT cycles by preparing validation evidence, explaining report logic, resolving defects, and coordinating with business stakeholders.
* Ensure solutions follow Huron standards for security, confidentiality, compliance, data governance, documentation, and supportability.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, automate repeatable tasks, reuse data assets, and improve model/report performance.
* Use approved AI-enabled and productivity tools responsibly to accelerate documentation, testing, analysis, and troubleshooting while validating outputs and protecting client/company data.
* Provide guidance to Analysts on assigned tasks, technical approach, documentation quality, testing discipline, and Power BI/data engineering fundamentals.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions, reusable templates, technical notes, and internal best practices.
* Work effectively across global teams, time zones, and virtual delivery environments.
* Perform other projects and tasks as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, Power BI development, reporting, or software/data platform delivery.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, ETL/ELT development, data mapping, data validation, and data modeling.
* Experience working with data warehouses, data lakes, Lakehouse platforms, or analytical database engines such as Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, DAX measures, data transformations, and visualization solutions.
* Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into technical designs, data models, dashboards, and tested analytics deliverables.
* Working knowledge of dimensional modeling, normalization, reporting grain, relationship design, and performance-aware Power BI modeling.
* Exposure to cloud data services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure storage/containers, AWS S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, Athena, Redshift, RDS, or comparable services.
* Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD workflows, sprint delivery, pull requests, and structured release processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across data pipelines, Databricks notebooks, SQL logic, Power BI refreshes, DAX calculations, access issues, and report performance.
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, user-facing notes, test evidence, and operational support procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with limited supervision while escalating risks and blockers appropriately.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Successful experience working with global teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Strong interpersonal, collaboration, analytical thinking, and teamwork skills.

Senior Analyst

title: Product Lead, Analytics
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling recently launched Data Cloud, opening up a new opportunity to help customers understand and act on data across their business. By bringing together first-party, third-party, and customer-created data across HR, IT, finance, and external systems, Rippling can answer business questions that traditional analytics tools struggle to connect.

As Product Lead for Analytics, you will turn this extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for enterprise and mid-market customers. You will own customer-facing analytics experiences and the shared capabilities that power analytics across Rippling—from intuitive reporting for business users to sophisticated analysis for advanced users.

This is a rare opportunity to define new AI-centric experiences beyond classic dashboards. You will build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, uncover insights, and proactively learn when meaningful events in their data need attention. AI will be the backbone of the features you ship—and a core part of how you build them.

Your core engineering team is based in India. You will work closely with engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and stakeholder teams across India and the USA to shape the product direction for a foundational part of Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Analytics within Rippling’s Data Cloud.
* Define and build new experiences for how customers analyze data in the AI era, extending beyond classic reports and dashboards.
* Make sophisticated analysis intuitive for admins and business users while giving advanced users the depth and flexibility they need.
* Build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, explain trends, and proactively discover meaningful events in their data.
* Partner with your India-based engineering team and engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and product stakeholders across India and the USA to deliver trusted analytics across Rippling and external data.
* Work directly with enterprise and mid-market customers to understand their needs, win adoption, and measure customer value.
* Use AI extensively to accelerate discovery, prototyping, delivery, and product iteration.

### **What you’ll need**

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex B2B products.
* Experience building analytics, BI, data platforms, or adjacent products; experience with shared platform capabilities is valuable.
* Strong customer and UX judgment, with the ability to make sophisticated analysis intuitive without sacrificing power.
* Technical fluency in data modeling, querying, metrics, and permissions, and the ability to work closely with engineering on product trade-offs.
* AI fluency: an understanding of how to build reliable AI and agentic experiences, evaluate their quality, and use AI effectively in your own work.
* Strong systems thinking, clear communication, and the ability to drive execution across teams and geographies with high ownership.
* Alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, and We go and see.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

title: Quant Analytics Associate
description:

**Job Description**

We are guided by curiosity, passion, and optimism, and we are dedicated to enabling growth opportunities for everyone.

As a **Quant Analytics Associate** on the **Travel Analytics** team (Consumer & Community Banking – Data & Analytics), you will drive strategic decisions through **deep-dive analyses and actionable insights**, ongoing reporting, and executive dashboards. You will translate travel and e-commerce data into recommendations that accelerate growth, improve partner and offer performance, and deliver measurable outcomes. You will collaborate closely with product, marketing, operations, finance, risk, and technology stakeholders to enable informed, data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across the organization. Success in this role requires strong analytical rigor, clear communication, and the ability to operate with high autonomy in a fast-paced environment.
